audit_items.proof_trace: Deduplication cache uses blockRoot (hash of BeaconBlockHeader including stateRoot, bodyRoot, parentRoot) as primary key instead of the spec-defined tuple (slot, proposerIndex, index). A malicious proposer can create multiple valid sidecars with same (slot, proposerIndex, index) but different roots, storing them in separate cache entries and bypassing deduplication entirely.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Malicious proposer with slot 100, proposerIndex 42 creates two DataColumnSidecars both with index=5 but different bodyRoot values. Both have valid proposer signatures. First sidecar cached under blockRootHex(A), second under blockRootHex(B). Both accepted, violating spec requirement of one sidecar per tuple.
